purpose: Bounded statement-level duplicate screen of the pinned corpus for a hyperbolic nonsofic group.
corpus_representative: frontier/sources/i79_logarithmic_girth_spectra_novelty_r3/outside/preprints: one top-level PDF per manuscript directory
authentication: 749 of 749 manuscript directories; every top-level PDF git blob SHA-1 matched a PDF blob of the same directory in sources/preprints-tree.json (SHA-256 eeecc1da49aa02877d137c4fb90339aca460ec27718b623916368bc08dc5e09b, 13223 entries, truncated false). Canonical tree has 749 manuscript directories, each with at least one PDF.
method: Fresh `pdftotext -q PDF -` replay of each authenticated PDF to stdout, case-insensitive grep for 'sofic'; separately ripgrep over the stored I79 .pdf.txt extractions for 'sofic' and 'hyperbolic'. No text written to disk.
conclusion: No pinned manuscript, as represented by its PDF text, states a hyperbolic nonsofic group or hyperbolicity of the source197 group. Source197's complete introduction and assembly assert no hyperbolicity; for the characteristic-two, odd-characteristic and determinant manuscripts only the matching lines and the author-read introductions were inspected, and none mentions hyperbolicity of its group. This is a bounded text screen; it does not establish literature novelty or priority, and PDF extraction may miss text.
